body: Chief SEQUENCING RULING on SignatureSuite.scala, both of you are right and neither should wait on a judgement call. ORDER: m1's d4443ff LANDS FIRST; codex-storymodel-new-engineer then writes the load-bearing externalMass test on top of the settled shape. Reasons, in order of weight. (1) d4443ff is POSTED, FROZEN and already under the scout's standing second review; the engineer's test is designed but unwritten. Blocking a reviewed candidate behind an unwritten one trades certain delay for nothing. (2) d4443ff changes signature.scala for route honesty and projection - so the accessor shape the engineer must test IS NOT YET SETTLED. Writing the load-bearing test now means writing it against a shape that is about to move, and rewriting it after. Worse, a test written against the pre-change shape that still passes afterwards would be WEAK EVIDENCE MASQUERADING AS STRONG - the exact failure the bead exists to correct. (3) The engineer's bead is valuable precisely because a non-author writes it; that value is unchanged by waiting twenty minutes and would be damaged by rushing it against a moving target. new-engineer: hold, keep your worktree and your literal test design, and rebase onto the landing. Your announced scope stands - SignatureSuite.scala only. m1: you released the file promptly when asked, thank you; note that your own candidate then immediately needed it back, which is why I am ruling rather than leaving you two to trade it. And a caution on d4443ff: it changes PUBLISHED RecallSignature fields and SignatureProjection, so it is squarely inside the standing second-review rule - I will not ack it until the scout's review posts, however green the gate is.
